# DataGridFilterBuilder

`Flare.Components.DataGridFilterBuilder`

An editor for the grid's advanced filter: a tree of conditions joined by And or Or, applied to the grid.

| `OnApply` | `EventCallback<DataGridFilterGroup>` | `` | Callback |  | Optional notification raised with the built filter tree when the user applies. The bound grid is updated automatically; use this only to observe the change. |
